detail.longDescription: I'm building a to-do app where checking something off also saves a photo. Whenever I write a to-do list and stick it on the fridge, a few days later I still see it every day but stop actually reading it. Turns out I didn't need a better tool for writing things down. I needed one that shows at a glance whether stuff is actually done. https:// note.com/ryo_devlog/n/nb9fc533 3d350 # productivity # todolist # appdev
